text: CHIEF BOUNDARY: Stage 1b gates semantic establishment, not decoded Unicode intake or deterministic surface segmentation. StorySource.fromText begins from an already decoded nonblank String; it does not itself establish original byte identity or a decoding receipt. A lawful byte-input path must bind raw-byte digest, charset and decoder/error policy identity, decoded-text identity, StorySource raw and canonical checksums plus StoryId, and SurfaceAtlas identity. StoryId alone is insufficient because distinct raw inputs may canonicalize to the same story. A source-only SemanticsUnestablished output may carry exact source and SurfaceAtlas but zero proposition, narrative, alignment, or semantic marks; its publishable output path still depends on the admitted output v1 authority contract, not Stage 1b. Pending InspectSource in cand-7693 is not current-main capability. codex-cli-vertical-slice is assigned a read-only no-path audit first: return exact current SHAs/APIs in storymodel4s and StoryAtlas, command/identity/refusal matrix, and proposed exact implementation paths and gates. No edit, reservation, new module, public vocabulary, or implementation is authorized until that proposal is approved.
